text.en:
All officials and employees in the government service, including contractual or emergency
personnel who render rural extension service in the "Paglilingkod: Bagong Lipunan" Program shall be entitled
to payment in advance of their basic salaries and to the commutation of vacation leave and payment of the
corresponding money value therefor, corresponding to the duration of their rural service. These payments
shall be for a maximum period of fifteen (15) days a year and in the case of vacation leave, shall not exceed in
any case the number of days leave credits actually available.

The Chairman, Civil Service Commission and the Commissioner of the Budget shall issue the
rules and regulations to implement this Decree.

All laws, rules and regulations inconsistent with this Decree are hereby amended or modified
accordingly.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 27th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-
